# Source of data/lookup/areas.json

Generated by `python3 scripts/kpi.py lookup` (scripts/build_lookup.py) on 2026-09-29.

## Administrative codes (DOPA-derived, open data)
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kongvut/thai-province-data/master/api/latest/province.json
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kongvut/thai-province-data/master/api/latest/district.json
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kongvut/thai-province-data/master/api/latest/sub_district.json

Repository: https://github.com/kongvut/thai-province-data (province/district/sub-district names and codes
of Thailand). Its `province_id` is an internal sequence, not the DOPA code, so the DOPA province code is
taken as `district.id // 100`; district code = `district.id` (4 digits); subdistrict code = `sub_district.id`
(6 digits). Result: 77 provinces, 930 districts, 7436 subdistricts.
<!-- areas:end -->

## Province -> health region (เขตสุขภาพ) table
- https://healthserv.net/1330  (MOPH 13 health regions, province lists; page also mentions NHSO regions, which are ignored)
- The healthserv page lists only 4 provinces for region 10 (ยโสธร is omitted, 76 of 77 provinces); ยโสธร was
  added to region 10 manually (MOPH region 10 = 5 provinces) and is verified by the Excel region-10 totals.
- Cross-check: a web-search summary of MOPH / regional-office pages agreed for regions 1-3 and 8-13 (not fetched in
  full); the whole table is validated by
  `kpi.py verify` (Coverage API grouped by this table must equal the HDC Excel `เขตสุขภาพ` country files 100%).

## Unit registry `data/lookup/units.json` (Phase 2, 2026-09-30)
- `https://opendata-service.moph.go.th/gis/v1/getgis/hoscode/{hoscode}` (MOPH GIS service, no auth, GeoJSON;
  `properties.provcode/distcode/subdistcode/hosname/hostype/dep`) → `units[hospcode] = {name, tambon (6-digit), hostype, dep}`.
- Built incrementally by `python3 scripts/kpi.py units` (also inside `fetch`/`update`) for every hospcode in the DSPM
  caches of the 8 provinces of health region 4. Live counts (codes, found / not in the registry, overrides): see
  README §4 "ตัวเลขสด" — not repeated here. A code whose GIS lookup fails (outage / timeout, e.g. 22754 on
  2026-10-02) is kept in `missing[...]` with `gisError` and retried on every run; after 3 consecutive failures the
  remaining new codes are skipped for that run.
- `missing[hospcode] = {maxTargetArea, target, areas[, gisError, gisFailedAt]}` = fallback information (areacode6
  with the unit's largest DSPM target, summed over the configured years — informational; the web applies the same
  rule per fiscal year, `scripts/indicators/common.py: fallback_tambon`) for units the registry does not know
  (private clinics `1xxxx/2xxxx`, local-government units `4xxxx`, …).
- `overrides[hospcode] = {tambon, source, note}` (optional, hand-kept top-level key; `kpi.py units` never drops it) =
  unit location confirmed from an HDC Excel export at ตำบล level; it wins over the GIS registry and the fallback.
- The district AND subdistrict levels of the web group rows by this unit location (HDC does the same). Order of
  rules: `overrides` > GIS registry > fallback. Verified against the HDC Excel exports at ตำบล level for the
  districts listed in `site/data/angthong/index.json → verified` (count and the 3 unresolved นนทบุรี districts: README §4,
  `docs/UNIT_LOCATION_HDC_2569.md`); อำเภอ level also matches the อ่างทอง / สระบุรี / อยุธยา province exports.

## Mandatory checks (performed in `kpi.py verify`, hard errors)
- every Excel oracle file is matched to its area by its row names (district names of one province / subdistrict
  names inside one district) — ambiguous or unknown names stop the pipeline;
- region 4 = นครนายก นนทบุรี ปทุมธานี พระนครศรีอยุธยา ลพบุรี สระบุรี สิงห์บุรี อ่างทอง.
